segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Hi Dana, thanks for making time. I wanted to walk through the renewal quote for the analytics workspace and make sure the seat count and dates match what you need for Q2.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Yeah, that works. We’re at 48 seats today, and we want to add 12 for the customer success team, so 60 total starting May 1.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Got it, 60 seats effective May 1. The current term ends April 30, so this would be a 12-month renewal through April 30 next year. The pricing sheet has that at $84 per seat per month, billed annually.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Okay, so that’s $60,480 before tax, right?

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Exactly. $84 times 60 seats times 12 months. Taxes will depend on the billing address, but the subtotal is $60,480.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: That matches what I expected. Can you keep the payment terms at net 30? Our AP team is pretty standard on that.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yes, net 30 is already on the quote. Same billing contact as last year, invoices at ap@northlakefoods.com?

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Yep, and please copy me on the first invoice. After that, AP can handle it.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Will do. For the added seats, do you want them available right on May 1, or should we enable them a few days earlier for setup?

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: May 1 is fine. We have training scheduled May 3 and May 4, so as long as the team can log in that morning, we’re good.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Perfect. I’ll send the order form today with the 60 seats, May 1 start, April 30 end date, annual billing, and net 30 terms.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Sounds good. Send it over, and I’ll route it for signature this afternoon.
